description: This file defines the LeaveEntitlement class, which represents the leave entitlement entity in the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It models leave entitlement data including employee, leave type, date range, number of days, and related associations. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes getter and setter methods for its properties.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlement
classes.description: An entity class representing a leave entitlement record for an employee, including leave type, date range, and related metadata, utilizing Doctrine ORM for persistence.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the leave entitlement.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the leave entitlement.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves the employee associated with this leave entitlement.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an employee with this leave entitlement.

methods.name: getNoOfDays
methods.description: Returns the total number of leave days entitled.

methods.name: setNoOfDays
methods.description: Sets the total number of leave days entitled, formatted to 4 decimal places.

methods.name: getDaysUsed
methods.description: Returns the number of leave days used.

methods.name: setDaysUsed
methods.description: Sets the number of leave days used, formatted to 4 decimal places.

methods.name: getLeaveType
methods.description: Retrieves the leave type associated with this entitlement.

methods.name: setLeaveType
methods.description: Associates a leave type with this entitlement.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Gets the start date of the leave entitlement period.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the leave entitlement period.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Gets the end date of the leave entitlement period.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the leave entitlement period.

methods.name: getCreditedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the entitlement was credited, if applicable.

methods.name: setCreditedDate
methods.description: Sets the credited date for the leave entitlement.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves the note associated with this leave entitlement.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets a note or comment for this leave entitlement.

methods.name: getEntitlementType
methods.description: Returns the type of leave entitlement.

methods.name: setEntitlementType
methods.description: Sets the entitlement type.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks whether the leave entitlement has been marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Marks the leave entitlement as deleted or not.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Gets the user who created this entitlement record.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Sets the user who created this entitlement record.
